in_hebrew.name: רוזנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Rosanne is derived from the Hebrew word 'rosh', which means 'head' or 'rose'. The suffix 'anne' is a common Hebrew feminine suffix, which means 'grace', 'favour', or 'gift'. So, the name Rosanne can be translated as 'graceful rose', 'favoured rose', or 'gift of the rose'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to this name, but it is similar to the Hebrew name 'Rosha', which is mentioned in the Old Testament (Joshua 19:14, 21).

in_greek.name: ῥόζαννη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Rosanne is derived from the Greek word 'rhodon', which means 'rose'. The suffix 'anne' is a common Greek feminine suffix, which means 'grace' or 'mercy'. So, the name Rosanne can be translated as 'graceful rose', 'merciful rose', or 'gift of the rose'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to this name, but the name Rose (ῥόδος) is mentioned several times in the New Testament, symbolizing Christ and His love (Song of Solomon 2:1; John 12:1-2).

in_latin.name: Rosanna
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Rosanne is derived from the Latin word 'rosa', which means 'rose'. The suffix 'anna' is a common Latin feminine suffix, which means 'grace'. So, the name Rosanne can be translated as 'graceful rose', 'gift of the rose', or 'merciful rose'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to this name, but the name Rosa is mentioned in the Vulgate translation of the Bible, which was the authoritative Latin version during the Middle Ages (Song of Solomon 2:1).
